entry.source_citation: Wiktionary: Il-Ħajja ma’ l-għarajjesdaret kollha daħkana (Alternative spelling of għana)

definitions.text_mt: Għamel xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa aktar għani jew sinjur

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħajja ma’ l-għarajjesdaret kollha daħkana tfisser li wieħed isir għani permezz taż-żwieġ
usage_examples.en: The saying 'Il-Ħajja ma' l-għarajjesdaret kollha daħkana' means that one becomes wealthy through marriage

usage_examples.mt: Il-proverbju jgħallem li ż-żwieġ idaħħal il-ġid fil-ħajja tan-nies
usage_examples.en: The proverb teaches that marriage brings wealth into people's lives

entry.source_citation: Wiktionary: Il-Ħajja ma’ l-għarajjesdaret kollha daħkana (Alternative spelling of għana)

definitions.text_mt: Għamel xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa aktar għani jew sinjur

usage_examples.mt: Il-proverbju jfisser li ż-żwieġ jarrikkixxi lill-bniedem
usage_examples.en: The proverb means that marriage enriches a person

usage_examples.mt: Jgħidu li l-ħajja ma’ l-għarajjesdaret kollha daħkana għax iż-żwieġ iġib il-ġid
usage_examples.en: They say that life with in-laws is all laughter because marriage brings wealth

definitions.text_mt: Ġie miġbur flimkien, inġema' ma' ħaddieħor

usage_examples.mt: In-nies iġġemmgħu fil-pjazza biex jisimgħu d-diskors
usage_examples.en: The people gathered in the square to listen to the speech

usage_examples.mt: Il-familja kollha iġġemmgħet madwar il-mejda għall-pranzu
usage_examples.en: The whole family gathered around the table for dinner

definitions.text_mt: Mexa minn post għall-ieħor mingħajr skop jew destinazzjoni fissa

usage_examples.mt: Il-klieb iġġerrew fit-toroq il-lejl kollu
usage_examples.en: The dogs roamed the streets all night

usage_examples.mt: Tħallix lil uliedek jiġġerrew waħedhom fil-belt
usage_examples.en: Do not let your children roam alone in the city

etymology_chain.definition: to fight each other by sword

definitions.text_mt: Involva ruħu f'ġlieda jew argument ma' xi ħadd

definitions.text_en: to fight (something), to fight with or against
definitions.text_mt: Ġġieled kontra xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd, ipprova jegħleb jew jeqred

usage_examples.mt: L-aħwa ż-żgħar iġġieldu dwar min kellu juża l-kompjuter l-ewwel
usage_examples.en: The younger siblings quarrelled over who should use the computer first

usage_examples.mt: Il-pajjiż iġġieled għall-indipendenza tiegħu għal ħafna snin
usage_examples.en: The country fought for its independence for many years

usage_examples.mt: Tgħallimt li mhux dejjem tista' tiġġieled kontra s-sistema
usage_examples.en: I learned that you cannot always fight against the system

definitions.text_mt: Annimal li għadu żgħir, speċjalment mamiferu
Frieħ tal-baqra, għoġol żgħir
Persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod mhux adult jew mhux responsabbli

usage_examples.mt: Il-baqra welldet qellux sabiħ lbieraħ filgħodu
usage_examples.en: The cow gave birth to a beautiful calf yesterday morning

usage_examples.mt: Tġibx ruħek bħal qellux; wasal iż-żmien li tikber
usage_examples.en: Don't behave like an immature person; it's time you grew up

definitions.text_mt: Parti tal-wiċċ bejn il-ħuġbejn u l-linja tax-xagħar

usage_examples.mt: Biesu fuq xbinha b’rispett kbir
usage_examples.en: He kissed her on the forehead with great respect

usage_examples.mt: Kellu xbin wiesa’ u għoli li jagħtih dehra nobbli
usage_examples.en: He had a wide and high forehead that gave him a noble appearance

definitions.text_mt: Qabel iż-żmien mistenni, sa issa, diġà

usage_examples.mt: Ġa tlaqna meta waslu huma
usage_examples.en: We had already left when they arrived

usage_examples.mt: Ġa għedtlek li ma nistax niġi l-ġimgħa d-dieħla
usage_examples.en: I already told you that I cannot come next week

definitions.text_mt: Ġab xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd miegħu lejn il-post fejn jinsab il-kelliem
Kiseb jew ipprovoka xi ħaġa biex tiġri

definitions.text_en: to fetch (a price), to sell for
definitions.text_mt: Kiseb ċertu ammont ta' flus bħala prezz tal-bejgħ

definitions.text_en: to form, to give shape (to something)
definitions.text_mt: Ta forma lil xi ħaġa, ħalqaha jew ifformalha

definitions.text_en: to work out, to form, to calculate
definitions.text_mt: Wettaq kalkolu jew ħadem problema biex wasal għal riżultat
Ta tweġiba mingħajr ċertezza u kellu raġun
Biddel id-direzzjoni jew l-istat ta' xi ħaġa
Biddel kliem minn lingwa għal oħra
Esprima xi ħaġa billi uża ċertu mezz jew format

definitions.text_en: to publish, to make public (in newspapers)
definitions.text_mt: Xandar jew ippubblika xi ħaġa f'gazzetta jew rivista
Poġġa lil xi ħadd f'riskju li jkun is-suġġett tal-ilsna tal-poplu
Ħalaq stampa mentali ta' xi ħaġa li mhix preżenti
Kellu stima għolja jew opinjoni tajba ta' xi ħadd
Ġiex ruħu b'ċertu mod f'sitwazzjoni partikolari
Żdied fid-daqs, fl-għoli jew fl-istatura
Wassal lil xi ħadd għall-orgasmu sesswali

usage_examples.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ġib il-ktieb minn fuq l-ixkaffa
usage_examples.en: Please bring the book from the shelf

usage_examples.mt: Din il-bidla se ġġib magħha ħafna problemi
usage_examples.en: This change will bring with it many problems

usage_examples.mt: Il-pittur ġab forma sabiħa mit-tafal
usage_examples.en: The artist formed a beautiful shape from the clay

usage_examples.mt: Qatt ma kont nimmaġina li jista' jiġri xi ħaġa bħal din
usage_examples.en: I never imagined that something like this could happen

definitions.text_mt: Ġab flimkien affarijiet li kienu mifrudin
Laqqa' nies jew affarijiet f'post wieħed

definitions.text_en: to admit (someone) to a mental hospital
definitions.text_mt: Daħħal lil xi ħadd f'sanatorju jew sptar tal-mard mentali

usage_examples.mt: Ġbart il-fwieħed kollha flimkien qabel ma bdejt inaddaf
usage_examples.en: I collected all the rubbish together before I started cleaning

usage_examples.mt: Il-Maltin iġabru l-flus għall-karità kull sena fil-Ġimgħa Mqaddsa
usage_examples.en: The Maltese gather money for charity every year during Holy Week

usage_examples.mt: Ġabruh l-isptar wara li kellu attakk psikotiku
usage_examples.en: They admitted him to hospital after he had a psychotic episode

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tbigħ il-ġobon u prodotti tal-ħalib

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġabban għandu ġobon frisk u ġobon maturat għall-bejgħ
usage_examples.en: The cheesemonger has fresh cheese and matured cheese for sale

usage_examples.mt: Mort għand il-ġabban biex nixtri rikotta għall-ħelu tal-Ħadd
usage_examples.en: I went to the cheesemonger to buy ricotta for Sunday's dessert

definitions.text_mt: Ġabar xi ħaġa għal rasu, akkumulaha għall-użu personali

usage_examples.mt: Ġabbar il-flus kollha li kellu għall-ivvjaġġar
usage_examples.en: He collected all the money he had for travelling

usage_examples.mt: Tista' ġġabbar l-affarijiet tiegħek qabel ma tlaqt
usage_examples.en: You can gather your things together before you leave

definitions.text_mt: Azzjoni ta' ġbir ta' affarijiet jew nies flimkien
Sett ta' oġġetti jew persuni miġbura flimkien

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm ġabra kbira ta' nies fil-pjazza għall-festa
usage_examples.en: There was a large gathering of people in the square for the feast

usage_examples.mt: Għandi ġabra ta' bollol minn madwar id-dinja kollha
usage_examples.en: I have a collection of stamps from all over the world

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġabra ta' poeżiji tiegħu ġiet ippubblikata s-sena l-oħra
usage_examples.en: His collection of poems was published last year

definitions.text_mt: Għamel ix-xagħar jitkagħda jew jingħalaq f'linji mgħawġa

usage_examples.mt: Il-parrukkier ġagħad xagħarha b'mod sabiħ għaċ-ċerimonja
usage_examples.en: The hairdresser curled her hair beautifully for the ceremony

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xagħar tiegħu jiġgħad naturalment mingħajr bżonn ta' ħadid
usage_examples.en: His hair curls naturally without needing an iron

definitions.text_mt: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa, ikkawża li xi ħaġa sseħħ
Uża l-poter jew pressjoni biex xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa kontra r-rieda tiegħu
Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jaġixxi b'ċertu mod minħabba ċirkustanzi jew awtorità

usage_examples.mt: Ġagħaltu jistenna siegħa sħaħ qabel ma wasalt jien
usage_examples.en: I made him wait a whole hour before I arrived

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġuħ ġagħalhom jaħdmu għal kull prezz
usage_examples.en: Hunger forced them to work for any price

definitions.text_mt: Marbut mal-moviment politiku rivoluzzjonarju Franċiż matul ir-Rivoluzzjoni Franċiża
Qarrieqi, li jqarraq jew iqarraq bl-oħrajn

usage_examples.mt: Il-klabb ġakbin kellu influwenza kbira fuq il-politika Franċiża
usage_examples.en: The Jacobin club had a great influence on French politics

usage_examples.mt: Kien magħruf bħala persuna ġakbina u frawdolenti
usage_examples.en: He was known as a deceitful and fraudulent person

definitions.text_mt: Membru tal-moviment politiku rivoluzzjonarju Franċiż matul ir-Rivoluzzjoni Franċiża
Persuna qarrieqa jew frawdolenta

usage_examples.mt: Robespierre kien wieħed mill-aktar ġakbini famużi fl-istorja Franċiża
usage_examples.en: Robespierre was one of the most famous Jacobins in French history

usage_examples.mt: Tajjeb li toqgħod attent minn dak il-ġakbin; mhux min jafdalu
usage_examples.en: You should be careful of that scoundrel; he is not to be trusted

definitions.text_mt: Azzjoni ta' qerq u tradiment kontra xi ħadd

usage_examples.mt: Dik kienet ġakbinata vera; qatt ma kont nistenna tradiment bħal dan
usage_examples.en: That was a real act of treachery; I never expected such betrayal

usage_examples.mt: Il-politiċi akkużaw lil xulxin b'ġakbinati matul il-kampanja elettorali
usage_examples.en: The politicians accused each other of acts of deception during the electoral campaign

definitions.text_en: a male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English James or Jacob
definitions.text_mt: Isem propju ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-Ingliż James jew Jacob

usage_examples.mt: Ġakbu huwa isem komuni f'pajjiżi li jitkellmu bil-Malti
usage_examples.en: James is a common name in Maltese-speaking countries

usage_examples.mt: San Ġakbu huwa l-qaddis patrun ta' ħafna knejjes madwar il-gżejjer Maltin
usage_examples.en: Saint James is the patron saint of many churches around the Maltese islands

definitions.text_en: jack (device for raising and supporting a heavy object)
definitions.text_mt: Għodda mekkanika għat-tneħħija u l-appoġġ ta' oġġetti tqal
Bandiera jew drapp imżejjen li jtajjar fuq bastiment biex jidentifikah
Armatura tal-ħadid li tkopri s-sider u d-dahar

usage_examples.mt: Uża l-ġakk biex tbiddel it-tajer tal-karozza
usage_examples.en: Use the jack to change the car tyre

usage_examples.mt: Il-bastiment kellu ġakk aħmar u abjad imtajjar fuq il-arblu
usage_examples.en: The ship had a red and white jack hoisted on the mast

etymology_chain.definition: a male given name from Hebrew, equivalent to English James or Jacob

definitions.text_en: a male given name from Italian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English James
definitions.text_mt: Isem propju ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-Ingliż James

usage_examples.mt: Ġakmu huwa wieħed mill-ismijiet l-aktar komuni fil-pajjiżi tal-Mediterran
usage_examples.en: James is one of the most common names in Mediterranean countries

usage_examples.mt: Lil Ġakmu staqsejt, imma ma kienx jaf it-triq għall-belt
usage_examples.en: I asked James, but he did not know the way to the city

definitions.text_en: a male given name from Italian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English Jacob
definitions.text_mt: Isem propju ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-Ingliż Jacob

usage_examples.mt: Ġakobb kien wieħed mill-patrijarki l-kbar tal-Bibbja
usage_examples.en: Jacob was one of the great patriarchs of the Bible

usage_examples.mt: Ħafna subien jisimhom Ġakobb għall-qaddis li għandu l-festa f'Lulju
usage_examples.en: Many boys are named Jacob after the saint whose feast is in July

definitions.text_mt: Segwaċi tar-Re Ġakbu II u d-dritt divin tar-rejiet wara r-Rivoluzzjoni Glorjuża

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġakobiti appoġġaw it-tbegħid tar-Re Ġakbu II u d-dixxendenti tiegħu
usage_examples.en: The Jacobites supported the restoration of King James II and his descendants

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġakobiti kellhom rwol importanti fl-istorja Skoċċiża tas-seklu tmintax
usage_examples.en: The Jacobites played an important role in eighteenth-century Scottish history

definitions.text_mt: Moviment politiku li appoġġa r-restawr tar-Re Ġakbu II u d-dixxendenti tiegħu fit-tron Ingliż

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġakobitiżmu kien forza politika sinifikanti fil-Gran Brittanja tas-sekli sbatax u tmintax
usage_examples.en: Jacobitism was a significant political force in seventeenth and eighteenth-century Great Britain

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġakobitiżmu tilef l-importanza tiegħu wara t-telfa ta' Culloden fl-1746
usage_examples.en: Jacobitism lost its importance after the defeat at Culloden in 1746

etymology_chain.definition: Jamaica (an island and country in the Caribbean )

definitions.text_en: Jamaica (an island and country in the Caribbean)
definitions.text_mt: Gżira u pajjiż fil-Karibew, magħruf għall-mużika reggae u l-bajjiet sbieħ

usage_examples.mt: Ġamajka hija magħrufa mad-dinja kollha għall-mużika reggae tagħha
usage_examples.en: Jamaica is known worldwide for its reggae music

usage_examples.mt: Zort li żort Ġamajka s-sena l-oħra; kien post mill-isbaħ
usage_examples.en: I was lucky to visit Jamaica last year; it was a beautiful place
